g.text: SD01 - UC01 Register an account (retail customer)
[A1: a required field is empty or invalid]
[A3: phone or e-mail is already registered]
Wholesale tab "Chủ tiệm bánh (Sỉ)": the form also asks for business name and tax code;
the account is created with status PENDING_APPROVAL until an Admin approves it (BR-04, UC14).
